 FC Juárez 0 – 1 Atlante Carrera 76' FULL TIME Highlights and Goals Juarez 0-1 Atlante in Liga MX
 Atlante defeated FC Juarez 1-0 thanks to a 76th-minute header from Nico Carrera, assisted by Martin Sarrafiore from a corner kick. The Potros withstood the home side's pressure to secure an important victory in Ciudad Juarez.
 Coverage by Daniel Medina Pérez Updated October 20, 2026, 11:00 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FULL TIME Last update 11:00 PM ET 10:58 PM ET an hour ago Full-Time: Atlante Claim a 1-0 Victory!
 It's all over! Atlante defeat FC Juarez 1-0 thanks to Nico Carrera's 76th-minute header from a Martin Sarrafiore corner. The Potros held firm in the closing stages to protect their lead and secure a valuable away win. Juarez pushed for an equalizer but could not find the breakthrough. A big victory for Atlante on the road!

The Potros look to protect their 1-0 lead, while the Bravos search for a late response to avoid defeat.

 78' 10:43 PM ET an hour ago Daniel Pina is shown a yellow card in the 78th minute for a bad foul as the Bravos try to regroup after Nico Carrera's goal gave Atlante the lead. The home side must respond quickly, with time running out and the score at 0-1.

 10:42 PM ET an hour ago ATLANTE ⚽ ⚽GOOOOOOOOOOOOOAL ⚽ ⏱️ 76'
 Atlante break the deadlock in the 76th minute! Nico Carrera rises inside the box and powers a header into the upper centre of the goal, giving the FC Juarez goalkeeper no chance. Martin Sarrafiore delivers the corner and provides the assist as the Potros take a 1-0 lead. The Bravos now have to respond in the closing stages.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 73' 10:41 PM ET an hour ago Edgar Jimenez is shown a yellow card in the 73rd minute for a bad foul. The second half remains fiercely contested, with fouls interrupting the flow as both teams search for a breakthrough. Juarez and Atlante are still level at 0-0 as the match enters its decisive stages.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez

Luca Martinez Dupuy replaces Ricardinho in the 70th minute, while Brayan Molina comes on for Madson de Souza Silva in the 71st. The Bravos are bringing on fresh legs and new attacking options in search of a goal against Atlante, with the score still 0-0.

 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 9:56 PM ET 2 hours ago Half-Time: Juarez 0-0 Atlante
 FC Juarez and Atlante head into the dressing rooms level at 0-0 after a competitive first half with several stoppages. The biggest moment came when Martin Sarrafiore scored for Atlante, only for the goal to be overturned following a VAR review. Sebastian Jurado also made an important save to deny Luis Calzadilla. Everything remains to play for in the second half.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 45+1' 9:49 PM ET 2 hours ago The fourth official signals six minutes of added time at the end of the first half. Juarez and Atlante have extra time to try to break the deadlock before the interval, with the score still 0-0 after VAR overturned Martin Sarrafiore's goal.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez
 41' 9:43 PM ET 2 hours ago The first half is entering its final minutes, with the score still goalless at Estadio Olimpico Benito Juarez. The match has featured several stoppages, midfield battles, and drama following Martin Sarrafiore's disallowed goal after a VAR review.
 Updates by Daniel Medina Pérez

 31' 9:41 PM ET 2 hours ago Atlante are denied the opening goal! Martin Sarrafiore had found the net in the 29th minute, but the incident was reviewed by VAR and the goal was eventually ruled out. The decision was confirmed in the 31st minute, leaving the score at Juarez 0-0 Atlante. The match remains level after a moment that could have changed the course of the contest.
